EC2: 2. Patients [NOT] without a definite diagnosis of hypertension（for instance, if the patient has been taking antihypertensive drugs irregularly, it is difficult to confirm the diagnosis of hypertension）.
EC3: 3. Patients with a definite diagnosis of secondary hypertension.
EC4: 4. Patients are diagnosed dyslipidemia with clear cause, such as nephrotic syndrome, severe hypothyroidism, terminal stage of malignancy, etc.
EC5: 5. Patients are diagnosed end-stage renal disease, [OR] hemodialysis, [OR] and peritoneal dialysis patients.
EC6: 6. Patients diagnosed with mental abnormalities [AND] who are [NOT] unable to complete the questionnaire.
EC7: 7. Patients have once participated in this research during this study cycle（to avoid repeated participation）.
